picks.why: A provider response makes enforcement actions concrete while separating its own account from independent verification.
An institution-by-institution coverage register explains what a legal-data service does not hold as well as what it claims to offer.
An explicit marginal-power model shows how capacity, utilization and generation assumptions shape a lab-specific emissions forecast.
A documented one-shot simulation task reveals shortcuts that attractive video alone can conceal, with single-run limits stated.
A role-reversal game uses hidden mission checks to distinguish a persuasive completion report from work actually done.
